notes.title: Game Update 5.0.0
notes.content: We've just updated the game to the latest version of the HexWar Engine. This includes various bug fixes and performance improvements!

notes.title: Civil War: 1861 = version 4.1.3 update
notes.content:
Change: The bonus 'Fowards!' Campaign is now available to all players without requiring an email registration.
 Fix: The campaign names did not always display correctly in the campaign victory display.

notes.title: Civil War: 1861 Version 4.1.1 Update
notes.content: Fix: Some sound effects not playing following the last update.

notes.title: Civil War: 1861 v4.1.0 Update
notes.content:
Change: A reduction in the download size.
 Change: Updated the combat capabilities of Cavalry armed only with Pistols.
 Change: Improved A.I. opponent.
 Fix: A critical issue displaying the curved loss meters after the previous graphics update.
 Fix: An error preventing the 'Game Updates' text from appearing.
 Fix: Invalid font selection on some buttons on some platforms.
 Fix: Some screen layout issues.
 Fix: Missing some mount dismount button options.
 Fix: Some projectile animations not displaying.
 Fix: Some screen layout issues.

notes.title: Historical Mode
notes.content:
Added a whole new way to play 'Historical mode'. 

In Historical mode all the unit values and chances to hit enemy units are as historically accurate as possible. 

As a result it may be much harder to destroy enemies resulting in missions being harder to complete.
